verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.58, VSAQ 129. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Revision (examiner audit, 2026-09-05): step 2's second mistake asked for regulated conditions that its own printed line does not carry and was replaced with a fin-fish check, and step 1's WHY now states that pisciculture is part of aquaculture, which was the relation its first mistake assumed.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Aquaculture
steps.why: Aquaculture covers every farmed aquatic organism, so prawns and oysters come under it as well as fish. Pisciculture is one part of aquaculture, not a separate practice.
steps.memory_tip: Aqua is water: all water animals.
lines: Aquaculture is the culturing of fish and
other aquatic organisms such as prawn,

steps.label: Pisciculture
steps.why: Pisces means fish, so pisciculture is the fish-only part of aquaculture.
common_mistakes: Making pisciculture the wider term. It is the narrower one.
Naming any aquatic animal. Pisciculture is fin fish only.
steps.memory_tip: Pisces is fish: fin fish only.

lines.text: Pisciculture is culturing and breeding fin fish

insider_note: Pisciculture is a part of aquaculture, not a separate thing. Say that aquaculture is the wider term.
